static_findings: Held pinned common/verifier source runs in private ModuleType dictionaries. Temporary sys.modules[common] is restored in finally after the import; imported function globals retain the correct private module for verify().

Runtime verification repeats the actual original supply acceptance, binds externally pinned report/guardian size+SHA and all three exact receipt/binary/lock/upstream fields, then rereads controller identity.
Supplied executable may be a Cargo hardlink. Its original executable/hash admission is retained; it is not incorrectly added to single-link control readonly_inputs.
Original 972d current probes still run in the fresh formal root after full source materialization/clone. Inputs and current source are verified again before exec of unchanged v8 full.

Original acceptance SHA is historical provenance for deriving the expected fields; the runtime request directly pins report and guardian and recomputes acceptance with pinned source, rather than requiring the historical acceptance output byte hash.
